prompt: 帮我把这个浏览器扩展上架到 Chrome Web Store、Firefox AMO 和 Edge，素材你看着补齐，最后提交。
expected: Triggers flow-ext-publish (not just ext-preflight). Step 1 runs ext-preflight to get missing items, passing known manifest/package.json info. Step 2 classifies gaps: routes missing marketing tiles to web-image (A路, built from real project screenshots/logo/copy — no AI-generated fake visuals), lists user-must-provide assets (B路), and builds a text checklist for descriptions/permissions justification/version (C路). Step 3 outputs structured pre-publish checklist and explicitly asks user to confirm generated assets + remaining gaps are ready — does NOT enter Step 4 yet. After explicit Step-3 asset confirmation, enters Step 4a and fills each platform's payload (build + web-ext lint allowed). Because the original request explicitly says '最后提交' (unambiguous upload authorization), the upload gate may be crossed: it then submits in fixed order Firefox AMO (Playwriter) → Edge (Playwriter) → Chrome Web Store (agent-browser --profile Default), then emits final report with review IDs. (If the user had only said 'prepare', it would instead stop at the upload gate and ask before submitting.)

prompt: 新版本做好了，准备发布扩展，这次只发 Chrome 就行。
expected: Triggers flow-ext-publish. Runs ext-preflight first, checks manifest version vs package.json consistency (stops in Step 2 to align if mismatched). Because user scoped to one platform, only Chrome Web Store is targeted — does NOT also submit Firefox/Edge. Classifies/auto-fills missing assets and presents Step 3 confirmation checklist, waiting for explicit user approval before proceeding. After Step-3 asset confirmation it enters Step 4a, fills the Chrome payload (build + web-ext lint + assembled listing fields + zip path) using agent-browser --profile Default as the designated tool — but because '准备发布' is only a preparation intent with NO unambiguous upload authorization ('自动上传/一把梭/直接提交'), it STOPS at the upload gate: outputs the assembled payload + final report (Chrome marked 'payload ready, awaiting upload authorization') and asks whether to actually submit. Does NOT call any store API / OAuth upload / browser submit until the user explicitly authorizes.

prompt: I want to submit my browser extension to the stores. Can you prepare everything and publish it?
expected: Triggers flow-ext-publish for the full end-to-end flow. Step 1 ext-preflight enumerates missing assets/blocking items. Auto-generates marketing images via web-image from existing project assets (1280×800 must use a real project screenshot as subject, else demoted to user-must-provide; no stock/fake visuals). Permissions justifications are extracted from project sources or marked 'pending user', never fabricated. Step 3 presents the consolidated checklist and waits for an explicit asset confirmation (vague replies like 'ok吧/嗯/随便' are re-clarified, not accepted). After confirmation enters Step 4a and fills each platform's payload. Because the request explicitly says 'publish it' (unambiguous upload authorization), the upload gate may be crossed: submits Firefox → Edge → Chrome in order with the mandated per-platform tools, then outputs the final report with review IDs. (Had the user said only 'prepare everything' without 'publish it', it would stop at the upload gate and ask before any actual store submission.)
